pipeline.title: BMS' ph. 3 Alzheimer's psychosis teaser builds confidence in Cobenfy expansion plan
pipeline.summary: After delaying the phase 3 readout of its Alzheimer’s psychosis program for Cobenfy earlier this year, Bristol Myers Squibb is offering an early peek that appears to bode well for the high-stakes data drops ahead, even as the fine details remain hazy.

pipeline.title: Priavoid’s Alzheimer’s pill fails to prove efficacy in phase 2 trial
pipeline.summary: Priavoid’s pill for Alzheimer's disease has failed to prove its effectiveness in a phase 2 dementia study, although the German biotech pointed to encouraging signs in the longer-term data.

pipeline.title: FDA clears MiniMed Fit tubeless insulin pump
pipeline.summary: MiniMed announced has picked up FDA clearance of its tubeless insulin pump, the MiniMed Fit.

pipeline.title: Cognito phase 3 flops in light-and-sound Alzheimer's trial, but sees ‘signal’ for HOPE
pipeline.summary: Cognito Therapeutics said its phase 3 HOPE study of Spectris AD, an investigational, non-invasive, at-home Alzheimer's therapy that uses light and sound stimulation to engage brain activity, failed to meet its primary endpoint.

pipeline.title: Merck axes $2.7B BTK inhibitor program after seeing phase 3 data
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. has stopped a trio of phase 3 blood cancer trials after one study suggested the benefits of the BTK inhibitor may fail to outweigh the risks, bringing the curtain down on a program stemming from a $2.7 billion takeover.

pipeline.title: FDA’s complete response letter for Summit’s ivonescimab cites China-heavy data beyond survival miss
pipeline.summary: The FDA’s rejection of Summit Therapeutics’ closely watched PD-1xVEGF bispecific ivonescimab extends beyond its previously reported failure to show a statistically significant overall survival benefit.

pipeline.title: Cosentyx bags FDA nod for 11th indication as Novartis looks to buffer 2029 patent cliff
pipeline.summary: Cosentyx's latest FDA approval marks the aging biologic's 11th indication and the first of the anti-IL-17 class to be approved for polymyalgia rheumatica.

pipeline.title: Roche’s next major breast cancer drug, Wilserdly, secures FDA approval as 4th oral SERD
pipeline.summary: Roche’s giredestrant took the first step toward what some analysts project could exceed $10 billion in peak annual sales, winning FDA approval for certain patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer.

pipeline.title: AriBio’s oral Alzheimer’s drug meets monotherapy goal in phase 3 as Fosun weighs licensing option
pipeline.summary: AriBio’s erectile dysfunction med-turned Alzheimer’s disease candidate mirodenafil has delivered some mixed results from a global phase 3 trial. Fosun Pharma has an option to in-license the PDE5 inhibitor.

pipeline.title: Sellas marks 9-month survival benefit in late-stage leukemia vaccine study
pipeline.summary: Sellas Life Sciences’ cancer vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia has passed a phase 3 test with a more than nine-month improvement in overall survival.

pipeline.title: Helus' chemically modified psychedelic hits key goals in phase 3 depression trial
pipeline.summary: Helus Pharma's oral chemically modified version of psilocybin hit the key goals of a phase 3 study as an adjunctive treatment in major depressive disorder.

pipeline.title: GSK scores FDA approval for Nelkarmi, its 2nd lung cancer drug from Nuvalent deal
pipeline.summary: On a hot streak, GSK has won a third high-profile FDA approval in recent weeks, this time for the second lung cancer drug from the British pharma’s $10.6 billion acquisition of Nuvalent earlier this year.

pipeline.title: ‘Selling and marketing snake oil’: The debate over compounded GLP-1s
pipeline.summary: Proponents of compounding argue it increases access, lowers prices and helps patients who may need individualized versions of a drug. But there are serious concerns, experts said at the HLTH conference.

pipeline.title: White House pulls nomination for FDA nominee Overton
pipeline.summary: The sudden end of Heidi Overton’s candidacy likely ensures a Democrat-controlled Congress will choose the FDA’s next leader — but shouldn’t disrupt the agency, analysts say.

pipeline.title: Beren clinches long-awaited FDA nod for cyclodextrin drug in Niemann-Pick disease
pipeline.summary: Beren Therapeutic's Lembaz was cleared by the FDA to treat the neurogenerative disorder Niemann-Pick disease type C in children as small as 15 pounds. It's the first NPC treatment to improve survival and to treat the cholesterol transport dysfunction that drives the disease.

pipeline.title: Pfizer leaps into ‘in vivo’ CAR-T with latest China deal
pipeline.summary: The potentially $2.6 billion collaboration puts Pfizer into a competitive race to treat autoimmune conditions by reprogramming cells inside the body.

pipeline.title: FDA moves to yank Salerno's liquid cholesterol drug approval on missing reports
pipeline.summary: In a notice posted on the Federal Register Wednesday, the FDA said that it has proposed withdrawing the approval for Salerno’s FloLipid, an oral suspension formulation of the long-approved cholesterol lowering medication simvastatin.

pipeline.title: Biogen’s tau therapy drives bigger benefits in 2-year Alzheimer’s update
pipeline.summary: Biogen has linked its tau-targeting antisense oligonucleotide to a further slowing of clinical decline after two years, leading analysts to hail the strengthening of evidence supporting late-phase development.

pipeline.title: FDA publishes rejection letter for Summit drug; Nuvalent buyout pays more dividends for GSK
pipeline.summary: The FDA had several issues with ivonescimab, according to the letter. Elsewhere, Sellas shares rocketed on results for a leukemia vaccine and Biogen and Lilly struck up new R&D pacts.

pipeline.title: Pfizer enters in vivo CAR-T space via 3-program, $2.6B deal with China’s Starna
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has decided to join the in vivo CAR-T race, penning a $2.6 billion deal for three preclinical candidates from China’s Starna Therapeutics.

pipeline.title: Less than a year into the job, Everett Cunningham steps down as Quanterix CEO
pipeline.summary: Quanterix is on the lookout for a new chief executive once again as Everett Cunningham, who only started the top job back in January, hits the exit.

pipeline.title: At Fierce’s London event, Big Pharmas tell biotechs to ‘be transparent’ to secure deals
pipeline.summary: Every biotech looking for a suitor wants to know: What does it take to charm a Big Pharma into a deal?

pipeline.title: Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination pulled by White House
pipeline.summary: The White House is pulling Heidi Overton’s nomination to lead the FDA just hours before the Senate was scheduled to vote on her confirmation.

pipeline.title: Vertex signs $220M deal with Genomics to re-up long-running discovery pact
pipeline.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals has re-upped its ties with sequencing specialist Genomics in a deal worth up to $220 million, signing on for an extra four years on top of the eight the companies have already worked together.

pipeline.title: Novo expands DTC program Novocare to support Wegovy users through holistic health journey
pipeline.summary: Members who sign up for Novo's new Novocare can benefit from holistic health services meant to support Wegovy users throughout the entirety of their weight loss journey.

pipeline.title: Scientists uncover ‘very detailed map’ of an enzyme target for rare metabolic disease
pipeline.summary: For some rare genetic diseases, the problem isn't a missing protein but the buildup of toxic molecules that the body can no longer clear away.

pipeline.title: Roche breast cancer pill cleared by FDA
pipeline.summary: Wilserdly’s U.S. approval is seen by analysts as a “key first step” in an important launch for Roche, which has claimed the drug could become its top-selling product.

pipeline.title: Medtronic pays $380M-plus for Contego Medical buyout
pipeline.summary: Medtronic is boosting its cardiovascular disease portfolio with a deal to buy up carotid artery disease and peripheral thrombectomy tech company Contego Medical.

pipeline.title: AI drugmaker Isomorphic restocks with $5B fundraise
pipeline.summary: Even as the larger AI industry faces turmoil, investors have given Isomorphic the two largest cash infusions in the biotech sector this year.

pipeline.title: AZ defeats health plan lawsuit alleging Soliris antitrust maneuvers
pipeline.summary: Winning a ruling in their favor Monday, AstraZeneca and its rare disease unit Alexion have successfully sidestepped U.S. antitrust allegations linked to aging rare disease drug Soliris.

pipeline.title: BeOne commits $3M to expand CLL Society patient education partnership
pipeline.summary: BeOne Medicines has expanded its partnership with CLL Society, entering into a three-year, $3 million pact to support leukemia and lymphoma patients.

pipeline.title: Kyntra axes mid-stage ADC, adding to years of stumbles
pipeline.summary: Beleaguered Kyntra Bio can’t catch a break. Formerly known as FibroGen, the company has endured a series of woes over the last few years, and now the biotech is cutting a clinical antibody-drug conjugate program from its mid-stage lineup.

pipeline.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B series C months after $2.1B round
pipeline.summary: Isomorphic Labs has raised a $5 billion series C round, marking the second time in six months that the AI drug development startup has pulled off a multibillion-dollar financing.

pipeline.title: USV chided by FDA over contamination risks at India site
pipeline.summary: Indian drug manufacturer USV was hit with a warning letter from the FDA that outlined three major violations. The observations largely centered on a lack of procedures that could lead to microbial and particulate contamination.

pipeline.title: Marrow sets out to challenge genetic medicines for severe blood diseases
pipeline.summary: Armed with $173 million in venture funding, the startup is developing what it’s positioning as a more accessible alternative to gene therapy and gene editing treatments for sickle cell and beta thalassemia.

pipeline.title: Why 2027 could be ‘Europe’s year to shine’: Panelists debate biotech funding at Fierce’s London event
pipeline.summary: Panelists at Fierce Biotech's London Life Sciences Week event discussed whether Europe can pull its weight in biopharma investment next year against the gravitational pull of the U.S. and China.

pipeline.title: Lilly signs $5.9B deal with Stipple to unlock oncology targets
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has struck a $5.9 billion deal to partner with Stipple Bio on oncology drug candidates that more precisely target tumor cells.

pipeline.title: Viatris takes the wheel as Cadillac F1 team's new global pharma partner
pipeline.summary: The multi-year partnership with Cadillac's Formula 1 Team makes Viatris the latest pharma to rev up a marketing play in the auto racing zone.

pipeline.title: Summit shares fall as FDA rejects closely watched PD-1/VEGF drug
pipeline.summary: The FDA refused to overlook ivonescimab’s failure to initially extend survival in a form of lung cancer, setting back Summit’s first chance to win a U.S. approval.

pipeline.title: CG Oncology drug delivers ‘exceptional’ results in key bladder cancer trial
pipeline.summary: CG’s therapy cretostimogene cut the risk of recurrence by 68% when administered after surgery, far surpassing Wall Street’s expectations and lifting company shares.

pipeline.title: J&J bets $2.2B on Ollin’s vision loss drug
pipeline.summary: The deal hands J&J a treatment that could complement its existing eye care franchise, but would vie for share of a crowded and competitive market.

pipeline.title: CG preps new, expanded bladder cancer plans with FDA after ph. 3 win
pipeline.summary: CG Oncology showed in a late-stage study that its immunotherapy cretostimogene reduced the risk of tumor recurrence in certain patients with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer following surgery.

pipeline.title: With Klygefa approvals, AZ expands myasthenia gravis domain beyond Soliris, Ultomiris
pipeline.summary: Continuing to harvest a bounty of autumn approvals, AstraZeneca has picked up nods for its C5 inhibitor gefurulimab to treat generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) on both sides of the Atlantic.

pipeline.title: Leo Pharma IPO plans stalled by market volatility: Bloomberg
pipeline.summary: Ownership behind Danish dermatology drugmaker Leo Pharma has opted to delay the company's plans for a 2026 IPO in the wake of ongoing market volatility.

pipeline.title: Biogen inks $411M neurodegeneration pact with protein degrader biotech TrimTech
pipeline.summary: Cambridge, U.K.-based TrimTech Therapeutics has linked up with Biogen in a collaboration worth up to $411 million in biobucks to develop protein degraders for neurodegenerative diseases.

pipeline.title: Roche’s Gazyva adds 3rd immune indication with first FDA nod for primary membranous nephropathy
pipeline.summary: As Roche’s Gazyva comes under pressure in blood cancer, the anti-CD20 antibody keeps expanding its reach in autoimmune diseases.

pipeline.title: Lilly secures another myelofibrosis option via $1.5B deal for JPM-founded Calytrix
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has added another myelofibrosis prospect to its pipeline courtesy of a $1.5 billion deal for Massachusetts biotech Calytrix Bio.

pipeline.title: Eisai, Linus Health launch ‘brain health’ digital resource
pipeline.summary: Japanese Big Pharma Eisai is teaming up with Boston-based digital health company Linus Health to create new “Brain Health Reports.”

pipeline.title: Quality over quantity: Healthcare messages not tuned into patient needs, survey finds
pipeline.summary: 58% of patients out of a 1,500 patient survey reported that healthcare communications don't consistently feel relevant to their needs, behavioral science-focused Lirio found.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca cuts 600 US sales jobs amid $1.5B savings plan: Bloomberg
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca’s $1.5 billion cost-savings drive has started to take a toll on its U.S. workforce. The British pharma has cut about 600 jobs from its respiratory and immunology commercial teams in the U.S., Bloomberg reports.

pipeline.title: FDA rejects Summit’s ivonescimab, derailing US arrival of much-hyped PD-1xVEGF class
pipeline.summary: The FDA has issued a complete response letter to Summit Therapeutics, derailing the immediate U.S. launch of a drug class that many industry heavyweights believe could eventually dethrone Merck & Co.’s Keytruda.

pipeline.title: Clene Nanomedicine uses CRO Veristat’s biostatistics platform for FDA submission
pipeline.summary: Clinical research organization Veristat has partnered with Clene Nanomedicine to accelerate data outputs for its FDA application for its ALS drug.

pipeline.title: Genentech brings every day wins to life in patient-focused Hemlibra push
pipeline.summary: New videos for Genentech’s “Life Doesn’t Wait” campaign showcase real patients and their families as they prove that their rare disease doesn't stop them from everyday life.

pipeline.title: Marrow extracts $120M series B to advance preclinical blood disease therapy
pipeline.summary: A new biotech targeting blood disorders, aptly called Marrow Therapeutics, has launched with $173 million in combined funding and a preclinical lead program aimed at sickle cell disease and beta thalassemia.

pipeline.title: Measurement Everywhere: Why the Future Can’t Be Measured in the Rearview Mirror
pipeline.summary: Stop measuring marketing in the rearview mirror. See how continuous measurement turns trusted signals into smarter decisions and action.

pipeline.title: Digital Twins: Advancing Clinical Evidence Strategy
pipeline.summary: Learn how patient digital twins can model treatment scenarios, strengthen comparator strategies and support evidence generation.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: Teva lands new FDA nod 3 weeks after picking up Igalmi
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.
